claims: Assess and manage hypotension with arterial line monitoring and vasopressor support as indicated.
Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and monitor respiratory status.
Trend arterial blood gases and lactate to assess acid-base status and perfusion.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit for anemia and consider transfusion if clinically indicated.
Monitor and replace electrolytes, including magnesium and potassium, as needed.
Assess and manage pain with the existing PCA and multimodal analgesia.
Perform sedation and delirium assessment using RASS and CAM-ICU.
Monitor blood glucose and continue insulin therapy as indicated.
Assess and manage volume status using central venous pressure, pulmonary artery pressures, and cardiac output.
Implement VTE prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin as ordered.
